CODE
2.3.14. 
Preferential allocation in the event of divorce
Where the matrimonial property regime is terminated by divorce on the basis of Article 229 of the former Civil Code, by legal separation or by judicial separation as to property, each of the spouses may, during the liquidation operations, request the Family Court to apply the provisions referred to in Article 2.3.13 in his or her favour.
The court decides in consideration of the interests that each of the spouses may assert and taking into account the financial capacity of the spouse who, if applicable, will have to pay the balance.
A request made by a spouse who has been the victim of an act referred to in articles 375, 398 to 400, 402, 403, 405, 409, ¤¤ 1 to 3 and 5, and 422bis of the Criminal Code or of an attempt to commit an act referred to in articles 375, 393 to 397, 401, 404 and 409, ¤ 4, of the same Code, if the other spouse has been found guilty of this offence as perpetrator, co-perpetrator or accomplice by a decision which has the force of res judicata.
